title: The Abstract Generation
coreMove: Diagnose the conditions that formed a thin-trust habit before judging it as attitude.
sourcePressure: Frames generation as formation under abstract conditions of belonging, approval, progress, and consequence, calling for concrete trust rather than stereotype.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Stereotyping millennials or any generation, or excusing all behavior as formation.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: training captain reading young medics as entitled
exampleSpecs.stakes: they were formed by checklist feedback and fear live judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she replaces sarcasm with ride-along trust reps that make standards concrete
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a trauma shears pouch beside a laminated feedback rubric

exampleSpecs.audience: professor seeing students chase likes on renderings
exampleSpecs.stakes: approval has been mediated and numerical
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he makes critique start with one peer naming a design tradeoff face to face
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a printed rendering pinned under metal clips

exampleSpecs.stakes: digital approval trains weak belonging before rehearsal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she pairs each new player with an in-person stand partner before judging commitment
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tablet audition form beside a music stand tag

exampleSpecs.audience: mentor noticing thin trust in Slack-only cohort
exampleSpecs.stakes: formation through messages leaves conflict brittle
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the mentor reviews the first conflict that moved from thread to room and what changed
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a chat transcript beside a room booking slip

exampleSpecs.stakes: habit reflects mediated reassurance, not just laziness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts rule-breaking, then creates radio check-ins that replace phone reassurance during activities
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a camp radio beside a phone lock pouch

exampleSpecs.audience: older tenant frustrated by app-only neighbors
exampleSpecs.stakes: both sides need concrete trust beyond platform ratings
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the board posts names and door hours beside the repair app queue
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a repair app screenshot beside a door-hours sign

skillTargets: translate generational friction into formation conditions
build concrete trust for thin-trust habits

tryThisNowSpec: When you feel contempt for a younger or older work habit, write the environment that may have trained it and the concrete trust practice that could retrain it.
sourceAnchorsNote: source contains no named anecdote for this chapter
